rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for encouraging someone to take action.

example.english: I always motivate my son to study on his own.
example.traditional: 我成日鼓勵個仔自己溫書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 gu2 lai6 go3 zai2 zi6 gei2 wan1 syu1

rows.note: Use this when something sparks a person's motivation, enthusiasm, or fighting spirit.

example.english: This movie can motivate me to start running again.
example.traditional: 呢套電影激發咗我重新開始跑步嘅鬥志。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 gik1 faat3 zo2 ngo5 cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2 paau2 bou6 ge3 dau3 zi3

rows.note: Use this when a person, policy, or incentive drives someone or a group toward continued action.

example.english: The company's bonus system can motivate everyone to keep working hard.
example.traditional: 公司個獎金制度推動大家繼續努力。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 go3 zoeng2 gam1 zai3 dou6 teoi1 dung6 daai6 gaa1 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6
